WORKFORCE / DEFENSE AND FEDERAL

Crew housing for
long federal programs.

For defense contractors, federal programs and base communities.

Private rooms with their own bath for crews near bases, missile fields and shipyards. Set on ground screws and moved when the program moves.

Start a conversationSee the units

THE PROBLEM

Big programs bring large crews to small towns.

Programs run for years. Crews need rooms near the work, and towns need housing that does not drain the local rental market.

WHERE IT FITS

Rooms beside the hub, the base or the yard.

Hubs
Rows of private rooms beside the dining, laundry and clinic a workforce hub provides.
Shipyards
Shipyard towns where hiring is outrunning the local rental market.
Islands
Pacific sites, with a climate package for hot, humid and storm-prone sites.
Access
Accessible units with a ramp in the mix where required.

PHASED WITH THE PROGRAM

From the hub to the next site, or to the town.

  • Phase 1

    Mobilize

    A pilot cluster for early crews and supervisors proves the site and utilities.

  • Phase 2

    Peak

    Add rows as headcount climbs. Two-key units add density.

  • Phase 3

    Wind down

    Units move to the next site on new ground screws.

  • Phase 4

    Leave housing

    Or units stay as local housing for the town, where approvals allow.

We supply units to prime contractors, camp operators and base communities. Each phase is scoped and quoted per project.
